title: Trusted Devices
description: Let a few of your own devices onto the WiFi without signing in.

errors.badMac: That doesn't look like a device address. Example: AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF
errors.noExpiry: Pick when access should end, or choose Always.
errors.pastExpiry: That time is in the past — pick a later one.

toast.saveFailed: Could not save — check the connection and try again.
toast.updateFailed: Could not update on the server.
toast.removeFailed: Could not remove on the server.

list.title: Trusted devices
list.description: Devices that connect straight to the WiFi without seeing the sign-in screen.
list.errorBody: This list is not available right now, so we can't show which devices are authorized. Nothing has changed — try again in a moment.
list.emptyBody: Click "Add device" above to let one of your own devices skip the sign-in screen.

dialog.title: Add a trusted device
dialog.description: This device connects straight to the WiFi without the sign-in screen.
dialog.addressHint: Its MAC address — find it under WiFi settings on the device itself. Dashes, spaces, or no separators are fine too, e.g. AA-BB-CC-DD-EE-FF.
dialog.accessEndsHint: After this the device signs in like any other guest.
